entries.labelZh: 调用宿主 AI 网关
entries.description: Send AI completion requests through the Host gateway so cost accounting, rate limits, and audit stay host-owned. Subject and cost gates still apply per request.
Append structured audit events under this extension's namespace.

entries.labelZh: 发布自身命名空间事件
entries.description: Publish events strictly under this extension's namespace through the Host event channel; core event names and other plugins' namespaces stay closed.
Invoke declared plugin services or providers through Host Service Discovery with live exact-artifact admission.
Perform allowlisted settings update/reset/action and disable of already-trusted non-system non-self plugins via Host Commands. Never replaces super_admin trust confirmation.
Read a redacted extension inventory and public runtime/contract state. Never exposes secrets, trust tokens, package paths, or credentials.
Use the versioned host surface (sforum.host/v1) for permission checks, settings, jobs, and audit.
Enqueue River jobs for job kinds declared in the plugin manifest only.
Open outbound network connections (HTTP, SMTP, etc.) from the plugin process or via Host helpers.
Ask the host whether an actor holds a permission key; cannot grant permissions.
Read and write settings belonging only to this extension.

Read the signed-in actor's own primary email address through the capability- and delegation-gated consent query. Never grants access to other users, never enters stable views, and every read is audited.
Read safe, non-secret user fields through the Host API.
